tools.name: PowerPoint Export
tools.author: santibraby
tools.description: Export artboards as an EDITABLE PowerPoint deck — text arrives as text boxes, images as image objects (crops intact). Imports into Google Slides.

tools.name: Eyedropper (Random 9)
tools.author: santibraby
tools.description: 9 individually-sampled random points shown on the image — click to place them as a 3×3 grid, X to reroll.

tools.name: Eyedropper (Square)
tools.author: santibraby
tools.description: Sample any color on the canvas and drop it as a scalable square swatch.

tools.name: Gantt Chart
tools.author: santibraby
tools.description: A cell grid with flowchart-style task bars: double-click a cell to type, drag bars between cells, stretch them across cells, +/− lines on hover, double-click a line to edit it (solid/dashed/delete).

tools.name: Glyphs
tools.author: santibraby
tools.description: Stamp simple stroke glyphs — star, lightbulb, bag, truck, wrench, ruler and friends — scalable, recolorable, replaceable in place.

tools.name: Guides
tools.author: santibraby
tools.description: Photoshop-style rulers and draggable guide lines. G toggles; guides never export.

tools.name: Grunge
tools.author: santibraby
tools.description: Dirty grunge plates on images — screen on the left, multiply on the right.

tools.name: Drop Shadow
tools.author: santibraby
tools.description: Drop shadows on images — a blurred rectangle offset 15px behind the crop box, like a print taped to the desk.

tools.name: Line
tools.author: santibraby
tools.description: Straight lines — drag to draw (Shift = 45° lock), three types (solid/dashed/dotted), pixel thickness 1–20, the app swatch colors.

tools.name: Sketch Note
tools.author: santibraby
tools.description: Hand-sketched arrows with handwritten notes — a wobbly pen stroke, an open drawn head, no bubble. Deterministic: exports exactly as drawn.

tools.name: Polygon
tools.author: santibraby
tools.description: Pen-style polygons with multiply inks, perspective-mapped image textures (drag 4 corners to fit), and donut holes — the polygon is the crop shape.

tools.name: Timeline
tools.author: santibraby
tools.description: A one-dimensional Gantt: a divided spine with labeled ticks that can become filled or open dots — same editing grammar as the Gantt chart.
